packages.name: RF Sim
packages.description: PCB antenna and RF chain simulation with openEMS
packages.description_full: Layout-aware RF simulation for KiCad 10 with openEMS: antenna simulation (impedance, efficiency, 3D radiation pattern, casing), matching-network tuning with E24 or real vendor parts and autotune, a mesh inspector, and values written back to the board. openEMS (GPL) is downloaded on the first run.
